title: Zesty Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: Winey and creamy, this low-sodium crowd-pleaser Jamaican curry is made with rapeseed oil and a nimono-style simmer. It combines zesty lime, coconut milk, and authentic spice blend for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Chicken thighs
ingredients.notes: skin removed, cut into 2.5 cm pieces

instructions: Heat rapeseed oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onions and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle in curry powder, paprika, and cayenne, stirring to coat for 30 seconds.
Add chicken pieces, browning them on all sides for 5 minutes, then pour in white wine to deglaze the pot.
Pour in low-sodium chicken broth and coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, reduce heat and cover, cooking for 25 minutes until chicken is tender.
Stir in lime juice, thyme, and season with salt and pepper, simmering for an additional 5 minutes to meld flavors.
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving over steamed rice.
